meaning: 無處不在的、遍布的、充斥著的
example: The pervasive influence of digital communication has fundamentally altered modern human interaction. (數位通訊無處不在的影響，從根本上改變了現代人類的互動方式。)
Rescue workers carefully excavated the concrete rubble following the catastrophic magnitude-7 earthquake. (在災難性的7級大地震後，救援人員仔細挖掘了混凝土瓦礫。)
Severe radioactive contamination rendered the entire industrial zone completely uninhabitable for decades. (嚴重的放射性污染使整個工業區在數十年內完全不適宜居住。)
Farmers must consistently adapt to the unpredictable vagaries of seasonal weather patterns. (農夫必須不斷適應季節性天氣模式變幻莫測的特點。)
The sudden, inexplicable drop in atmospheric pressure puzzled the airport's meteorological team. (大氣壓力突然且無法解釋的下降，讓機場的氣象團隊感到困惑。)
The two corporate boards maintained an antagonistic relationship throughout the hostile takeover negotiations. (在惡性併購談判期間，這兩個公司董事會全程保持著敵對的關係。)
The government introduced strategic tax incentives to catalyze private investments in renewable infrastructure. (政府推出了策略性的稅收激勵措施，以促進民營資本對再生基礎設施的投資。)
Rapid industrial growth merged several neighboring independent municipalities into a sprawling modern conurbation. (快速的工業增長將幾個鄰近的獨立地方政府，合併為一個蔓延的現代大都市圈。)
Industrial wastewater often contains highly corrosive chemical agents that degrade concrete drainage systems. (工業廢水通常含有高度腐蝕性的化學物質，會降解混凝土排水系統。)
The Arctic expedition traversed a completely desolate frozen landscape entirely devoid of vegetation. (北極探險隊橫越了一片完全荒涼、毫無植被的冰封大地。)
The ruling party implemented constitutional changes designed to permanently entrench its political authority. (執政黨實施了旨在永久確立其政治權威的憲法修正。)
The legislative ethics committee conducts rigorous annual audits of every elected public officeholder. (立法道德委員會每年對每位民選的公共官員在職者，進行嚴格的審計。)

meaning: 價格高得令人望而生畏地
example: The advanced laboratory medical equipment was prohibitively expensive for small independent research clinics. (高階的實驗室醫療設備，對於小型獨立research診所來說價格高得令人望而生畏。)
The administrative board provided a comprehensive scientific rationale for implementing the strict lockdown. (行政委員會為實施嚴格的封鎖措施提供了全面的科學依據。)
The rifle's intense mechanical recoil can surprise novice marksmen during initial target practice. (步槍強烈的機械反作用力，可能會在最初的射擊練習中讓新手射手感到驚訝。)
Certain amphibian species possess the extraordinary biological capability to regenerate entire lost limbs. (某些兩棲類動物擁有非凡的生物學能力，能夠完全再生失去的四肢。)
The environmental protective agency implemented highly restrictive regulations on industrial carbon emission levels. (環境保護署對工業碳排放水平，實施了高度限制性的法規。)
Without regular structural capitalization and corporate innovation, small business enterprises can easily stagnate. (在缺乏定期結構性資金注入與公司創新的情況下，小型企業很容易陷入停滯。)
The masterfully engineered architectural dome was supremely stable, enduring multiple structural earthquake tests. (這座工藝精湛的建築圓頂極其穩定，經受住了多次結構性地震測試。)
The physician recommended therapeutic mineral baths to alleviate the patient's chronic muscle inflammation. (醫生建議進行有療效的礦物浴，以緩解患者長期的肌肉發炎。)

meaning: 跡象明顯的、絕對錯不了
example: The distinct fossilized footprints left an unmistakable record of prehistoric predatory dinosaur movement. (這些獨特的化石足跡，為史前肉食性恐龍的移動留下了絕對不會錯的記錄。)
Geologists mapped a massive subterranean river system flowing deep beneath the limestone plateau. (地質學家繪製了一個流經石灰岩高原深處的巨大地下河流系統地圖。)
The advanced electric vehicle accommodates five adult passengers comfortably while maintaining extreme battery efficiency. (這款先進的電動車可在保持極高電池效率的同時，舒適地容納五名成年乘客。)
The historical archive's chief custodian is responsible for preserving delicate documents dating back centuries. (歷史檔案館的首席管理員，負責保存追溯至數個世紀前的脆弱文獻。)

meaning: 宗教派別、紙鈔面額面值
example: The historic museum contains banknotes of every legal denomination printed during the civil conflict. (這家歷史博物館收藏了內戰衝突期間印刷的每一種法定面額之紙鈔。)
The newly updated server infrastructure functioned dependably throughout the high-traffic global retail event. (新更新的伺服器基礎設施，在整個高流量的全球零售活動中皆可靠地運作。)
Computer graphics artists utilize specialized programming tools to render complex three-dimensional topographical models. (電腦圖形藝術家利用專業的程式設計工具，來渲染複雜的三維地形模型。)
The architectural monument was distinctively designed, combining raw structural concrete with delicate geometric glass. (這座建築紀念碑的設計非常獨特，將原始的結構混凝土與精緻的幾何玻璃結合在一起。)
Medical researchers are ethically obligated to obtain informed consent from every active human participant. (醫學研究人員在道德上，有義務獲得每位積極參與的人類受試者之知情同意。)

meaning: 群居的、社交的、愛交際的
example: Wolves are highly gregarious animals that rely on structured pack dynamics to hunt successfully. (狼是高度群居的動物，依賴有結構的狼群互動來成功狩獵。)

meaning: 人文主義者、人文主義的
example: The Renaissance scholar advanced a humanist curriculum that prioritized classical literature, history, and ethics. (文藝復興時期的學者提出了一門人文主義課程，將古典文學、歷史和倫理學列為優先。)
The porous specialized clay structures can rapidly imbibe fluid compounds from the surrounding environment. (這種多孔的專用黏土結構，能夠迅速吸收周圍環境中的液體化合物。)
Wood-boring termites can easily infest timber residential structures if protective coatings are neglected. (如果忽略了保護性塗層，木白蟻很容易大批滋生於木製住宅結構中。)

meaning: 不可彎曲、僵化缺乏彈性
example: The corporation's inflexible management policies prevented it from adapting to the shifting consumer demands. (該公司僵化缺乏彈性的管理政策，阻礙了其適應不斷變化的消費者需求。)
The historical museum contains several early nineteenth-century prints produced via advanced stone lithography. (這座歷史博物館藏有數幅透過先進石版印刷術製作的19世紀早期印刷品。)
The whistleblower detailed the loathsome working conditions that factory laborers were forced to endure. (吹哨者詳細描述了工廠勞工被迫忍受的令人厭惡之工作環境。)
The biological nervous system functions to modulate sensory inputs based on surrounding light levels. (生物神經系統的功能是根據周圍的光線水平來調整感官輸入。)
The traditional tribal performance relied on dynamic, percussive rhythms produced by handmade wooden drums. (傳統的部落表演依賴手工木鼓所產生的動態敲擊節奏。)
Earth's magnetic polarity has undergone multiple complete reversals over the course of geological history. (在地質歷史的進程中，地球的磁極性經歷了多次完全倒轉。)
The elderly professor tended to ramble during lectures, occasionally deviating from the scheduled syllabus. (這位年邁的教授在講課時往往會東拉西扯，偶爾偏離了既定的教學大綱。)
Without proper state monetary controls, rampant inflation can rapidly destabilize a developing nation's economy. (在沒有適當國家貨幣控制的情況下，猖獗的通貨膨脹會迅速使開發中國家的經濟不穩定。)
The expanding retail conglomerate ruthlessly undercut local businesses to secure an absolute market monopoly. (這家不斷擴張的零售集團無情地壓低價格以削弱當地企業，從而確保絕對的市場壟斷。)
Media critics condemned the news channel for prioritizing tabloid sensationalism over objective investigative reporting. (媒體評論家譴責該新聞頻道將小報的煽情主義置於客觀的調查報導之上。)
The prominent clinical surgeon maintained a successful commercial sideline as a medical textbook author. (這位傑出的臨床外科醫生保持著一個成功的商業副業——擔任醫學教科書作者。)
The executive report succinctly summarized the complex financial merger within a single comprehensive brief. (該主管報告在一份全面的簡報中，簡潔地概述了這起複雜的財務合併案。)
The tropical depression brought torrential rain that caused catastrophic flash flooding along coastal rivers. (熱帶低氣壓帶來了傾瀉的暴雨，導致沿海河流沿線發生災難性的山洪暴發。)
Tectonic plate movements cause gradual structural deformation of the Earth's crust over geological eras. (板塊運動在地質年代中，導致了地球地殼逐漸發生的結構變形。)
Genetic testing allows modern individuals to trace their deep geographic ancestry back thousands of years. (基因檢測讓現代人能夠將其深厚的地理血統追溯到幾千年前。)
The tropical plant species possesses highly aromatic leaves used in the production of organic perfumes. (這種熱帶植物擁有高度芳香的葉子，可用於生產有機香水。)
Laboratory technicians conduct daily calibration of the sensitive mass spectrometers to ensure precise scientific measurements. (實驗室技術員每天對敏感的質譜儀進行校準，以確保精確的科學測量。)
The diplomat warned against forming any strategic military alliance that could lead to geopolitical entanglement. (外交官警告不要建立任何可能導致地緣政治糾纏的策略性軍事聯盟。)
The international trade agreement focused entirely on the technological facilitation of cross-border customs processing. (該國際貿易協定完全聚焦於跨國海關處理在技術上的便利化。)
The decades-long political feud between the two prominent families severely destabilized the municipal government. (這兩個著名家族之間長達數十年的政治世仇，嚴重動搖了地方政府的穩定。)
The early diplomatic skirmishes over trade barriers served to foreshadow the full-scale geopolitical conflict. (早期圍繞貿易壁壘的外交小衝突，預示了全面地緣政治衝突的到來。)
The central bank introduced sudden interest rate hikes to forestall a potential real estate bubble. (中央銀行突然實施升息措施，以預先阻止潛在的房地產泡沫化。)
Astrophysicists study cosmic microwave background radiation to understand the exact genesis of the early universe. (天體物理學家研究宇宙微波背景輻射，以了解早期宇宙確切的起源。)
The university dean was widely celebrated for his genial demeanor and accessibility to undergraduate students. (該大學院長因其和藹親切的舉止以及對大學生的平易近人而廣受讚譽。)
The structural engineer verified that the heavy concrete mixture contained precise levels of mineral grit. (結構工程師驗證了厚重的混凝土混合物中含有精確水平的礦物砂礫。)
The complex aerial gyration performed by the acrobatic jet team required split-second flight synchronization. (特技噴射機隊所進行的複雜空中旋轉，需要精確到分秒的飛行同步。)
The aerospace engineering team developed a lightweight aluminum honeycomb structure to reinforce the aircraft's wings. (航空太空工程團隊研發了一種輕量化的鋁製蜂巢狀結構，以加固飛機的機翼。)

meaning: 無法克服的、難以逾越的
example: The deep ocean trench presented what initially seemed like insurmountable technical obstacles for exploration teams. (深邃的海溝最初對探測隊來說，呈現出看似無法克服的技術障礙。)
The ecosystem's survival is intimately linked to the preservation of its primary apex predator populations. (該生態系統的生存，與其主要頂級捕食者族群的保護密切地相關。)
The dynamic character in the play expressed a deep longing for freedom and social autonomy. (劇中充滿活力的角色表達了對自由和社會自主權的深切渴望。)
The indigenous elders held an extensive knowledge of botanical lore, utilizing wild herbs for medicine. (原住民長老掌握了豐富的植物學傳統知識，利用野生草藥來治病。)
The historic city's unique cultural landscape is a vibrant melange of indigenous and colonial architecture. (這座歷史城市的獨特文化景觀，是原住民與殖民時期建築的一種充滿活力的混合物。)
Critics argued that the play relied excessively on theatrical melodrama rather than authentic character development. (評論家認為這部戲劇過於依賴誇大的舞台通俗劇，而非真實的角色發展。)
There is a common public misconception that all bacteria are harmful pathogens, ignoring beneficial microbes. (大眾普遍存在一個錯誤觀念，認為所有細菌都是有害的病原體，而忽略了有益的微生物。)
The modernist artist painted a stunning monochromatic mural utilizing various shades of deep cobalt blue. (這位現代主義藝術家利用不同深淺的鈷藍色，繪製了一幅令人驚嘆的單色壁畫。)
In ancient mythologies, the sky deity was frequently depicted as an omnipotent ruler overseeing humanity. (在古代神話中，天空之神經常被描繪成掌控全人類的全能統治者。)
The arctic hunters carefully preserved the thick bear pelt to provide insulation against subzero temperatures. (北極獵人仔細保存了厚重的熊毛皮，以提供抵禦零下溫度的絕緣保護。)
The textbook serves as an excellent primer for students entering the field of evolutionary biology. (這本教科書對於進入演化生物學領域的學生來說，是一本極佳的入門書。)
The young computer scientist achieved international prominence after developing an innovative open-source cybersecurity protocol. (這位年輕的電腦科學家在開發了一款創新的開源網路安全協定後，獲得了國際著名的地位。)
The massive volcano remained quiescent for over three centuries before suddenly erupting with explosive force. (這座巨大的火山在突然以爆炸性力量噴發之前，曾保持沉寂休眠了三個多世紀。)
The corrupt executive demonstrated no scruples whatsoever when embezzling millions from the corporate pension fund. (該名腐敗的高階主管在從公司退休基金中侵占數百萬美元時，表現出毫無任何良心上的顧忌。)
The international medical agency moved to standardize chemical testing protocols to ensure global vaccine safety. (國際醫療機構採取行動使化學測試協定標準化，以確保全球疫苗的安全。)
The newly discovered deep-sea marine organism was strikingly different from any previously classified species. (這種新發現的深海海洋生物，與任何先前分類的物種皆顯著地不同。)
Human rights organizations actively campaign against the exploitation of textile labor within any industrial sweatshop. (人權組織積極發起反對在任何工業血汗工廠內剝削紡織勞工的運動。)

meaning: 棋盤格嵌鑲、棋盤狀圖案
example: Architects utilized a stunning geometric tessellation of marble tiles to decorate the central cathedral floor. (建築師利用大理石瓷磚構成的精美幾何棋盤格嵌鑲，來裝飾中央大教堂的地板。)
Specialized winter tires are engineered to maintain maximum traction on icy and snow-covered roadways. (專用的冬季輪胎經過精心設計，能在結冰與被雪覆蓋的道路上保持最大的摩擦牽引力。)
The sudden cancellation of the international flight unavoidably disrupted the schedule of the diplomatic summit. (國際航班的突然取消，無可避免地打亂了外交峰會的行程。)
The ideological dispute created an unbridgeable divide between the two political factions during constitutional drafting. (在起草憲法的過程中，意識形態的爭議在兩個政治派別之間造成了無法跨越的鴻溝。)
Epidemiologists documented a sudden upsurge in seasonal influenza cases during the unusually cold winter months. (流行病學家記錄了在異常寒冷的冬月期間，季節性流感病例的突然急劇上升。)
Biochemists analyze snake venom to discover active compounds that can be utilized in cardiovascular medications. (生物化學家分析蛇毒，以發現可用於心血管藥物的活性化合物。)
The prominent planetary scientists discovered clear geological evidence of ancient, large-scale volcanism on Mars. (著名的行星科學家在火星上發現了古代大規模火山活動的明確地質證據。)
The local public university received a massive multi-million dollar bequest from a prominent former graduate. (當地公立大學收到了由一位傑出前畢業生所提供的一筆高達數百萬美元的巨額遺贈。)
Corporate complacence following years of market monopoly left the tech giant completely vulnerable to innovative startups. (多年市場壟斷帶來的公司自滿，讓這家科技巨頭在面對創新新創公司時完全不堪一擊。)
The ancient monument was covered in cryptic inscriptions that historical linguists have struggled to fully decipher. (這座古代紀念碑上佈滿了神秘隱晦的銘文，歷史語言學家一直難以完全破譯。)
The sheer magnitude of the global climate crisis did not daunt the determined young environmental researchers. (全球氣候危機的龐大規模，並未使意志堅定的年輕環境研究人員感到氣餒。)
The elite athletic club hosted an international equestrian competition that featured world-class show jumping events. (這家菁英體育俱樂部舉辦了一場國際馬術比賽，以世界級的障礙超越賽為特色。)
The United Nations framework aims to ensure an equitable distribution of global environmental resources among nations. (聯合國框架旨在確保全球環境資源在各國之間得到公平的分配。)
The anthropological research team conducted a rigorous, multi-year ethnographic study of the remote Amazonian community. (個人類學研究團隊對偏遠的亞馬遜社區，進行了一項嚴謹且為期多年的民族誌研究。)
The sudden economic crisis served to galvanize the legislative assembly into passing the structural banking reforms. (突然爆發的經濟危機，成功激勵了立法議會通過結構性的銀行改革方案。)
During the historical heyday of transatlantic steam travel, thousands of grand vessels crossed the ocean weekly. (在跨大西洋蒸汽航行歷史上的全盛時期，每週有數千艘宏偉的船隻橫渡海洋。)
A horde of tourists descended upon the historic ruins as soon as the summer gates opened. (夏天的景點大門一開，一大群遊客便蜂擁而至這座歷史遺跡。)
Despite receiving the prestigious international accolade, the lead scientist maintained a posture of profound professional humility. (儘管榮獲了享譽國際的知名榮譽，這位首席科學家仍保持著極具專業素養的謙遜姿態。)
The clinic detected the disease in its incipient stage, allowing for highly effective early medical treatment. (診所偵測到了該疾病的初期階段，從而能進行高度有效的早期醫療。)
The glaring incongruity between the politician's lavish lifestyle and his public rhetoric alienated working-class voters. (該政治人物奢侈的生活方式與其大眾言論之間明顯的不協調，疏遠了勞工階層選民。)
The rare migratory avian species visits the northern wetland preserve only infrequently during major solar events. (這種珍稀的遷徙鳥類只有在大規模太陽活動期間，才會罕見地拜訪北方濕地保護區。)
The indigenous artifact was intricately carved from jade, displaying delicate patterns that represented local mythic narratives. (這件原住民文物是由玉石錯綜複雜地雕刻而成，展示了代表當地神話敘事的精細圖案。)
The student newspaper's satire was marked by a sharp irreverence toward the university's traditional administrative hierarchy. (學生報紙的諷刺文章以對大學傳統行政體制的尖銳不敬為特色。)
The structural integrity of the high-rise skyscraper was engineered to withstand immense lateral wind forces. (這棟高層摩天大樓的結構完整性，經過工程設計能承受巨大的橫向風力。)

meaning: 特立獨行、不服管教的人
example: The tech entrepreneur was widely regarded as a corporate maverick who consistently rejected traditional industry models. (這位科技創業家被廣泛視為公司中特立獨行的人，他一貫拒絕傳統的產業模式。)
The continuous urban layout spanning from Boston to Washington D.C. forms a massive Eastern megalopolis. (從波士頓延伸到華盛頓特區的連續城市佈局，形成了一個巨大的東部特大城市群。)
Certain non-venomous insect species display mimetic patterns that replicate the color warnings of deadly wasps. (某些無毒的昆蟲物種展示出模仿擬態的花紋，複製了致命黃蜂的顏色警告。)
The elderly author's memoir offered a nostalgic reflection on rural life during the pre-industrial era. (這位年邁作家的自傳對工業化之前的農村生活進行了懷舊的反思。)
The intense geothermal conditions functioned over millions of years to petrify the buried ancient forest timber. (強烈的地熱條件在數百萬年裡發揮作用，使埋藏的古代森林木材石化。)
The historic industrial city maintained an economic predominance in steel manufacturing throughout the late twentieth century. (在整個20世紀後期，這座歷史悠久的工業城市在鋼鐵製造業中保持著經濟上的主導地位。)
Aerospace engineers designed the cabin to pressurize automatically as the experimental aircraft ascended beyond the clouds. (航空太空工程師將機艙設計為隨著實驗飛機升入雲端而自動加壓。)
